resources.string: Open a compact assistant window with the system assistant button or gesture. Type, record original audio, take a screenshot, or share your screen. Audio requires a model with audio and tool support and is sent only after confirmation. The side bubble pauses the task. After upgrading, select None and then Minis again if the old full-page entry remains. Phone-control permissions and system gestures are configured separately.
Open Android Settings → Apps → Default apps → Digital assistant app and choose Minis.
Unlock your phone, then invoke Minis again.
